frames.label: Build
frames.caption: bb builds it through MLIR and LLVM, and runs it
frames.say: The moment of truth. b b builds it. Intent goes straight from the program's structure to MLIR, then LLVM, and out comes a native executable, with no text to parse along the way. And since LLVM is underneath, calling a C library is just declaring the C function. It runs: the ball is one and a half metres ahead, and one point two metres below where it started. Already on its way down.
